detail.message: Daily Free AI limit reached (3/3 AI requests). Your general operation allowance is unchanged; paid plans have no daily AI cap.

rendered_quota_copy: Guests upload up to 50 MB per file; signed-in Free accounts have no plan-specific file cap within the 500 MB service maximum. Exam Pass uploads are limited to 500 MB. Recurring paid plans have no plan-specific file cap within the 500 MB service maximum. Free and guest accounts: up to 10 accepted server operations per day, including at most 3 successful AI requests. Chat, summarize, extract, and translate each count as one AI request and one server operation. One multi-file batch counts once. Browser-local processing and requests rejected before acceptance do not count. A queued PDF/photo job still counts if processing later fails; failed AI or Studio requests refund their reservation when the failure is reported. Paid plans have no daily operation or AI cap. Your plan: up to 10 files for Merge, JPG/PNG to PDF, and Scan to PDF. Free, Student & Educator, and Exam Pass are capped at 10; All-In-One Pro & Developer plans allow 100. Compare takes two PDFs. Photo Merge takes 2–10 images.
